events.text: In December 2024, Gamuda's near-term and net-zero targets were officially validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi), making it the first and only construction and engineering company in Malaysia to reach this milestone.
Gamuda Berhad partnered with OCBC Bank Malaysia for its inaugural Shariah-compliant sustainability-linked financing facility totaling up to RM550 million.
Gamuda remains committed to renewable energy projects with a RM2bn capex budget set aside for the next 5 years, leveraging its 30% stake in ERS Energy Sdn Bhd.
Gamuda halted work at its Sungai Rasau site in Puchong following an embankment collapse at the Sungai Rasau Water Supply Scheme (Stage 1) project.

Gamuda issued a media statement on 16 May 2023 on the Penang South Reclamation project, which Sahabat Alam Malaysia, Consumers' Association of Penang and Penang Forum called self-serving and unsustainable.
